## Functions
```{r}
fitting <- function(statistics, counts) {
    factor <- 0
    loglik <- rep(0, 100 * 100)
    for (j in unique(statistics$N)) {
        if (j == 0) next
        slimdata <- statistics %>% filter(N == j)
        slimI <- as.numeric(unname(table(factor(slimdata$I, levels = 0:(O-1)))))
        factor <- factor + log(factorial(sum(slimI))) - sum(log(factorial(slimI)))
        slimfreq <- counts %>% filter(N == j)
        loglik <- loglik + apply(slimfreq[, 1:O], 1, \(x) sum(slimI * log(x)))
    }
    loglik <- loglik + factor + sum(dnbinom(unique(statistics$N), size, p, log = T))
    cbind(loglik, slimfreq %>% select(R0:phi))
}
```

## Hyperparams
```{r}
N <- 42
O <- 50

R0 <- seq(from = 0, by = 0.05, to = 5 - 0.05)
pi <- seq(from = 0, by = 0.0025, to = 0.25 - 0.0025)
phi <- seq(0, by = 0.1, to = 10 - 0.1)

mu <- 97
var <- 516
lambda <- 516 / 97 - 1

p = mu / var
size = p * mu / (1 - p)
```

## CME data
```{r}
cmemat <- read.table("eitan_data/host_cme_matrix.txt", header = T, sep = "\t")
cmes <- colnames(cmemat %>% select(-host_id))
cmemat$aid <- str_split(cmemat$host_id, "_", simplify = T)[, 1]
cmemat$genome <- str_split(cmemat$host_id, "_", simplify = T)[, 2]
hostdat <-  read.table("eitan_data/hosts.txt", header = T, sep = "\t")
cmemat <- left_join(cmemat, hostdat %>% select(species, genus, family, host_id), by = "host_id")
cmetab <- read.table("eitan_data/cme_table.txt", header = T, sep = "\t")
cmedat <- cmemat %>% 
    group_by(aid, species) %>% 
    summarize_at(cmes, \(x) sum(x) != 0) %>% 
    select(-species) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = -aid, names_to = "cme") %>% 
    group_by(cme, aid) %>% 
    summarize(count = sum(value), .groups = "drop")
```

## N and I data
```{r}
fams <- cmemat %>% filter(c4) %>% pull(family) %>% unique
Nstats <- cmemat %>% filter(family %in% fams) %>% 
    group_by(aid) %>% select(aid, species) %>%
    distinct %>% summarize(N = n())
Istats <- cmemat %>% filter(c4) %>% group_by(aid, species) %>% 
        summarize(n = n()) %>% summarize(I = n())
statistics <- left_join(Nstats, Istats, by = "aid")
statistics <- rbind(statistics,
                    data.frame(aid = unique(hostdat$aid), 
                               N = 0, I = NA)[!(unique(hostdat$aid) %in% statistics$aid), ])
statistics[is.na(statistics)] <- 0
statistics <- statistics %>% select(-aid)
```

## Convert simulations to correct format
```{r}
converter <- function(i) {
    tmpcounts <- data.frame(t(read.csv(paste0("c4results/counts_", i,".csv"), header = F)))
    tmpcounts$R0 <- R0[i]
    tmpcounts$pi <- 0
    tmpcounts$phi <- 0
    for (j in 1:100) {
        for (k in 1:100) {
            tmpcounts$pi[100 * (j - 1) + k] <- pi[j]
            tmpcounts$phi[100 * (j - 1) + k] <- phi[k]
        }
    }
    shapely <- matrix(0, 10000 * 160, 54)
    for (j in 1:160) {
        shapely[10000 * (j - 1) + (1:10000), 51] <- j
        shapely[10000 * (j - 1) + (1:10000), c(1:50, 52:54)] <-
            as.matrix(tmpcounts[, c(50 * (j - 1) + (1:50), 8001:8003)])
    }
    shapely <- data.frame(shapely)
    colnames(shapely)[51:54] <- c("N","R0","pi","phi")
    write_csv(shapely, paste0("c4results_reshape/counts_", i,".csv"))
}
for (i in c(1:100)) {
    print(i)
    converter(i)
}
```

## Fitting
```{r}
logliks <- matrix(0, 100 ^ 3, 4)
readandfit <- function(i) {
    counts <- suppressMessages(read_csv(paste0("c4results/counts_", i, ".csv")))
    counts[, 1:O] <- counts[, 1:O] + 1 / 10
    divider <- rowSums(counts[, 1:O])
    counts[, 1:O] <- apply(counts[, 1:O], 2, \(x) x / divider)
    fitting(statistics, counts)
}
for (i in 1:100) {
    print(i)
    logliks[(1:10000) + 10000 * (i - 1), ] <- as.matrix(readandfit(i))
}
logliks <- as.data.frame(logliks)
colnames(logliks) <- c("loglik", "R0", "pi", "phi")
write_csv(logliks, "logliks.csv")

getinterval <- function(var) {
    var <- "pi"
    profiled <- logliks %>% group_by(!!!syms(var)) %>% summarize(loglik = max(loglik))
    plot(profiled[1:10, ])
    interval <- 2 * (max(logliks$loglik) - profiled$loglik) <= qchisq(0.95, 1)
    range(unlist(profiled[, var])[interval])
}
R0hat <- median(getinterval("R0"))
pihat <- median(getinterval("pi"))
phihat <- median(getinterval("phi"))
```

## Examining c4
```{r}
readcounts <- read_csv(paste0("c4results/counts_", which(R0 == R0hat), ".csv"))
plotcounts <- readcounts %>% 
    filter(round(pi, 4) == round(pihat, 4), round(phi, 1) == round(phihat, 1)) 

gatherNI <- colSums(plotcounts[statistics$N, 1:O])
gatherNI <- gatherNI / sum(gatherNI)

cmedat %>%
    filter(cme == "c4") %>% pull(count) %>% 
    factor(levels = 0:(O-1)) %>% table %>% data.frame %>% 
    rename(count = '.', freq = Freq) %>% 
    mutate(count = as.numeric(count) - 1, 
           freq = freq / sum(freq)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = count, y = freq)) +
    geom_col(width = 1, color = "black", fill = "white")+
    ylim(0, 1) + xlim(-1, 20) +
    theme_classic() +
    ggtitle("c4") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12, family = "mono"),
          legend.position = "bottom")

data.frame(count = 0:(O - 1), freq = gatherNI[1:O]) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = count, y = freq)) +
    geom_col(width = 1, color = "black", fill = "white")+
    ylim(0, 1) + xlim(-1, 20) +
    theme_classic() +
    ggtitle("best fit") +
    theme(text = element_text(size = 12, family = "mono"),
          legend.position = "bottom")
```
